ABOUT US

Prestige Luxury Real Estate

Established in 2007, Prestige Luxury Real Estate is a leading luxury real estate agency in Dubai, specialising in residential and commercial property sales, leasing, property management and real estate investment advisory.

With over 100 dedicated real estate professionals, we combine extensive local market knowledge, established industry relationships and personalised service to connect buyers, sellers and investors with exceptional properties across Dubai.

From luxury apartments and waterfront residences to exclusive villas and commercial properties, our portfolio spans some of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.

Our expertise extends across every stage of the property journey, from identifying the right investment opportunity and arranging property viewings to expert negotiations and ownership transfers.

At Prestige Luxury, we believe every property decision deserves the right expertise. Our commitment to integrity, transparency and lasting client relationships has shaped our reputation as a trusted real estate company in Dubai.

Our Real Estate Services

Explore comprehensive real estate services in Dubai, tailored to your residential, commercial and investment requirements.

Residential Property Sales

Explore luxury properties for sale in Dubai, including premium apartments, exclusive villas, townhouses and waterfront residences, with expert guidance throughout the buying process.

Residential Leasing

Discover properties for rent in Dubai with personalised support for property searches, viewings, lease negotiations and tenancy arrangements.

Commercial Property Sales & Leasing

Find commercial properties in Dubai, including offices, retail spaces and investment opportunities suited to your business and financial objectives.

Property Management Services

Our property management services in Dubai support landlords and investors with tenant coordination, leasing administration and ongoing property oversight.

Property Valuation & Advisory

Make confident property decisions with professional property valuation in Dubai, supported by market insights, comparative analysis and expert advice.

Real Estate Investment Advisory

Explore Dubai property investment opportunities with personalised guidance on market trends, emerging locations and long-term investment potential.

The Prestige Commitment

Every Property Decision Deserves the Right Expertise.

Whether you’re buying a luxury home, selling an investment property or exploring Dubai’s commercial real estate market, our experienced property advisors are committed to making every step informed, efficient and seamless.

Exceptional Properties. Expert Advisory. Trusted Relationships.

Prestige Luxury
ستوصلك لحياة الرفاهية التي تستحقها!

العقارات التي نختارها مصممة لتمنحك أسلوب حياة لا مثيل له من حيث الرفاهية والرقي، فكل عقار منها مميز بتصميمه عالي الجودة ودقة تفاصيله.

هذه العقارات الفاخرة تقع في أرقى المناطق من دبي لتمنحك سهولة حياة المدينة وراحة حياة الترف معاً في آن واحد.

تهدف Prestige Luxury لتؤمن لك تجربة حياة فريدة تتميز بالرفاهية سواءً كنت تبحث عن تاون هاوس أو فيلا فاخرة، هذه العقارات مصممة لتلبي احتياجاتك وتفوق توقعاتك.

مجموعة العقارات المنوعة التي يمكنك الوصول إليها عن طريق Prestige Luxury ستكون تجسيداً لحياة الترف التي تطمح إليها وتستحقها، بأسلوب حياة مميز يجمع بين العصرية والرخاء.

احجز استشارة مجانية

آراء عملائنا

سكالوولد ليتا
كان العمل مع إلميرا رائعاً، حيث استجابت لمكالماتنا ورسائلنا على الفور وكانت متجاوبة بنفس القدر مع ملاك العقار أثناء مساعدتنا في العثور على منزل جديد. كما أن معرفتها في المجال تستحق التقدير من حيث ما هو متاح وفيما كانت توقعاتك للأسعار تتوافق مع أرض الواقع أم لا.
نحن مسرورون جداً ونتطلع لمنزلنا الجديد وممنون جداً لتجربتنا الناجحة مع إلميرا!
شارميلا موهناني
من حسن حظي أني التقيت بالسيد إلياس صلاح من Prestige Luxury للعقارات. فهو نشيط جداً ومتعاون وإنسان ذكي للغاية ومريح، كما أنه صبور وساعدنا كثيراً. اندهشنا أنا وزوجي كثيراً بأداءه، حيث كان ملتزماً معنا ومتفانياً جداً.
نتمنى له نجاحاً مبهراً في مستقبله، كما نتمنى النجاح ل Prestige Luxury.
كوريسكالب
لا يسعني إلا أن أوصي بخدمات Prestige Luxury للعقارات، وخصوصاً إيما أودونيل. كنا نعاني من تجربة سيئة مع وكالة مشبوهة عندما عثرنا على إيما وPrestige Luxury بمحض الصدفة. ساعدونا في إيجاد شقة ممتازة بسعر مناسب خلال أيام وحسب ونظموا كل شيء وأكثر بالتكيّف مع جدول أعمالنا وملاقاتنا بعد أوقات الدوام والتأكد من سير كل الأمور على ما يرام مع مالك العقار ومعنا شخصياً.

لكل من يقرأ، كونوا متأكدين أنكم تعملون مع محترفين حقيقيين واطلبوا التعامل مع إيما، فهي لطيفة ومجدة وتمتلك ضميراً حياً.

PROPERTY SELLING PROCESS

Step 1: Property Appraisal Our specialized agents will assess your property based on current market conditions and compile a detailed property valuation report. This step ensures you receive an accurate and comprehensive understanding of your property’s value.

Step 2: Marketing Preparation Upon your agreement to proceed, we will begin crafting a tailored marketing campaign for your property. Our goal is to present your property in the best possible light to attract potential leads.

Step 3: Professional Photography and Listing Our team of professional photographers will showcase your property’s best features. Together with a compelling listing description, we aim to generate a high volume of leads by capturing the essence and appeal of your property.

Step 4: On-site Advertising Based on the nature of your property, we will place ‘For Rent’ or ‘For Sale’ signage prominently outside your property. This traditional method complements our online efforts by attracting local potential buyers or tenants.

Step 5: Online Advertising We will feature your property on leading property portals—fully leveraging the quality photographs and detailed descriptions to ensure it stands out from the competition. This step is crucial for wide visibility and attracting interested parties.

Step 6: Digital Media Strategy In addition to property portals, we employ a diverse digital media strategy to promote your property. This includes advertising on platforms such as Facebook, Google, LinkedIn, and Instagram to reach a broader audience and maximize exposure.

BOOK A FREE VALUATION


Why Sell Your Property in Dubai with Prestige Luxury?

Sell your property in Dubai with Prestige Luxury Real Estate, one of the highest lead-generating real estate companies in Dubai. We will market your property with the highest quality through our significant marketing spend to ensure more interest.

No matter the reason for selling, we are here to offer expert advice. Come visit us at our office in Marina Plaza, Dubai Marina.

They say strength is in numbers, this rings true when choosing a real estate broker to help you sell your property in Dubai. We have over 100 brokers potentially working on your behalf to help ensure your property is sold as quickly as possible, for as much as possible. Every day, our offices communicate to ensure buyers are informed about different properties in different offices, ensuring the maximum return for all involved.

Our well-trained, expert real estate brokers are dedicated to specific areas, ensuring impeccable community knowledge. Therefore, our brokers are in a position to advise you on market trends in your area to ensure you market your property at the best price possible and target serious buyers.

To find your perfect buyer, you need to give your property maximum exposure across a wide range of media. When you instruct us to sell your property in Dubai, you will automatically benefit from our unmatched marketing package, including exposure on our award-winning website, full-colour property details, listings on property websites including Property Finder, Dubizzle, and Bayut, video tours, professional pictures, and email and SMS alerts. We spend more on marketing than any other real estate company in Dubai.

The Prestige Luxury Real Estate in-house sales progression team will ease you through the sale process once the contracts are signed, and it’s time to address all the legal processes involved with selling your property in Dubai. Their aim is to make the process as seamless as possible from obtaining the No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the developer through to the transfer. Your sales progressor will make sure all of your documents are in order before beginning the process to avoid delays.

Our Properties

We cover residential and commercial properties in over 50 communities in Dubai.

Whether you are renting a property or looking to buy, we have an array of homes for you to choose from.

Properties for Sale
Properties for Rent

Questions about selling

How to sell property in Dubai if I cannot be personally for the registration process?

It is necessary for you to be in person for the process, otherwise you can come to register your property any other people with a Power of Attorney from you, where it will be described all the power in details on an owners behalf such as to cover the registration process into the seller’s name, to include the set up of the utility account and so on.

Could you describe the sales and purchase process?

In most instances, the transaction process goes as follows:

  • Buyer chooses the property.
  • Buyer and seller sign the sales and purchase agreement, where all the terms and conditions of the deal are mentioned: the purchase price, additional expenses (agency fee, transfer fee at the DLD, developer’s fee, service charge refund, etc), the transfer date of the deal at the DLD, terms of payment and clearly-defined responsibilities and penalties for both parties in case they fail to uphold the conditions set out in the agreement.
  • On signing the agreement, the buyer pays the deposit. This is usually 10% of the purchase price.
  • The seller applies for a no-objection certificate (NOC) from the developer in order to sell the property. The NOC is required for the transfer process at the DLD.
  • Once the NOC is ready, the buyer and seller can transfer the property and register it on the buyer’s name. Usually, payments need to be made at the time of registration.
Where is it necessary to conduct a deal and transfer of ownership?

All the transfers concerning a deal should be handled with the help of the designated Dubai Land Department Trustee Offices in Dubai. It is significant that all the parties pertaining to the financial transactions have to be present. Prestige Luxury Real Estate always informs their clients about all necessary documents and payments which are required on the day of the transfer.

What are the guarantees that I receive real and fair price for property that corresponds to the current real estate market situation?

Prestige Luxury Real Estate will offer you as a client, all the historical and factual market figures in order to support the correct price for the property. After that, a seller and an agency have to sign Form A, where a seller will accept and confirm to list the property for sale for a stipulated price.

title: Frequently Asked Questions

seo.title: Frequently Asked Questions | Prestige Luxury Real Estate
seo.description: A list of commonly asked questions and answers about selling, renting or buying a proeprty in Dubai, United Arab Emirates

html:
Frequently Asked Questions

Questions about selling

Could you describe the sales and purchase process?

In most instances, the transaction process goes as follows:

  • Buyer chooses the property.
  • Buyer and seller sign the sales and purchase agreement, where all the terms and conditions of the deal are mentioned: the purchase price, additional expenses (agency fee, transfer fee at the DLD, developer’s fee, service charge refund, etc), the transfer date of the deal at the DLD, terms of payment and clearly-defined responsibilities and penalties for both parties in case they fail to uphold the conditions set out in the agreement.
  • On signing the agreement, the buyer pays the deposit. This is usually 10% of the purchase price.
  • The seller applies for a no-objection certificate (NOC) from the developer in order to sell the property. The NOC is required for the transfer process at the DLD.
  • Once the NOC is ready, the buyer and seller can transfer the property and register it on the buyer’s name. Usually, payments need to be made at the time of registration.

Questions about renting

How do we put an offer forward?

Your Prestige consultant will guide you through the process.  This will involve fully understanding and your requirements and position so we can clearly forward this to the landlord and do our best to secure the property for you.  A deposit amount is payable immediately upon acceptance, your consultant can advise on the amount.

Questions about Property Management

Will I get a discount if I have multiple properties?

Discounts are subject to review and Management Approval.

If I take property management will you also assist me in selling my property?

Yes, because we are not just a management company, we are also a brokerage company that specialize in renting and selling.

Can I pay after the property gets rented?

Yes, but you will have to pay a minimum of AED 3000 to cover the cost of management before the property is rented.

What if I am not satisfied with the service, how does cancellation work?

In the unlikely event that you are unhappy with the service we provide, we will require from you a 90-day notice letter in writing giving us reason for termination.  The Managing Agent agrees to refund any outstanding rental funds held after relevant deductions made to the property (such as community charges, approved payments by you (Owner).

General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)

We are a Data Controller of your information.

Prestige Luxury Real Estate legal basis for collecting and using the personal information described in this Privacy Policy depends on the Personal Information we collect and the specific context in which we collect the information:

  • Prestige Luxury Real Estate needs to perform a contract with you

Prestige Luxury Real Estate will retain your personal information only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We will retain and use your information to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our policies.

If you are a resident of the European Economic Area (EEA), you have certain data protection rights. If you wish to be informed what Personal Information we hold about you and if you want it to be removed from our systems, please contact us.

In certain circumstances, you have the following data protection rights:

  • The right to access, update or to delete the information we have on you.
  • The right of rectification.
  • The right to object.
  • The right of restriction.
  • The right to data portability
  • The right to withdraw consent

Log Files

Prestige Luxury Real Estate follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. All hosting companies do this and a part of hosting services’ analytics. The information collected by log files include internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable. The purpose of the information is for analyzing trends, administering the site, tracking users’ movement on the website, and gathering demographic information.

Cookies and Web Beacons

Like any other website, Prestige Luxury Real Estate uses ‘cookies’. These cookies are used to store information including visitors’ preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed or visited. The information is used to optimize the users’ experience by customizing our web page content based on visitors’ browser type and/or other information.

For more general information on cookies, please read “Cookies” article from the Privacy Policy Generator.

Privacy Policies

You may consult this list to find the Privacy Policy for each of the advertising partners of Prestige Luxury Real Estate.

Third-party ad servers or ad networks uses technologies like cookies, JavaScript, or Web Beacons that are used in their respective advertisements and links that appear on Prestige Real Estate, which are sent directly to users’ browser. They automatically receive your IP address when this occurs. These technologies are used to measure the effectiveness of their advertising campaigns and/or to personalize the advertising content that you see on websites that you visit.

Note that Prestige Luxury Real Estate has no access to or control over these cookies that are used by third-party advertisers.

Third Party Privacy Policies

Prestige Luxury Real Estate Privacy Policy does not apply to other advertisers or websites. Thus, we are advising you to consult the respective Privacy Policies of these third-party ad servers for more detailed information. It may include their practices and instructions about how to opt-out of certain options.

You can choose to disable cookies through your individual browser options. To know more detailed information about cookie management with specific web browsers, it can be found at the browsers’ respective websites.

Children’s Information

Another part of our priority is adding protection for children while using the internet. We encourage parents and guardians to observe, participate in, and/or monitor and guide their online activity.

Prestige Luxury Real Estate does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 13. If you think that your child provided this kind of information on our website, we strongly encourage you to contact us immediately and we will do our best efforts to promptly remove such information from our records.

Online Privacy Policy Only

Our Privacy Policy applies only to our online activities and is valid for visitors to our website with regards to the information that they shared and/or collect in Prestige Luxury Real Estate. This policy is not applicable to any information collected offline or via channels other than this website.

Consent

By using our website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.
